paragraphs: The Ibirapema Warrior is the Tupi unique infantry unit in Age of Empires. Carrying a heavy wooden club, this warrior is built for close combat against other infantry.
Foot archers can threaten it from a distance, so reaching the enemy is an important part of the fight.
Its powerful frontal area attack can strike enemies gathered in front of it. A tightly packed formation can give each swing more targets than a single opponent.
These battles test whether the elite warrior can bring that strength to bear before the enemy wears it down. Each main army fights with equal resources and a fixed unit cap.
